ev.q: This report describes five cases of fungal infection associated with contaminated drugs prepared at a compounding pharmacy.
Isolates from four of the five infected persons reported were tested in vitro and were susceptible to voriconazole, itraconazole, and amphotericin B.

This report describes five cases of fungal infection associated with contaminated drugs prepared at a compounding pharmacy.
As of December 5, five cases of Exophiala infection associated with injectable medication from compounding pharmacy A had occurred.
